title: Private Rate Schedules for Bed-Hold Nights in Resident Funds Returns
content:
For a bed-hold overcharge returned to a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, the nightly rate due for a night is the private daily rate that the rate schedule in effect that night sets for the room tier priced. The rate schedule in effect follows the date of each night due on the charge under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations:

| Date of the night due | Rate schedule in effect |
|---|---|
| on or after 2026-07-01 | the schedule taking effect 2026-07-01 |
| from 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 | the schedule taking effect 2025-07-01 |
| before 2025-07-01 | the schedule in effect on the date the charge was billed; a charge billed before 2025-07-01, before either schedule this policy prices, keeps the charge's own daily rate |

## Both sides of each date (hypothetical nights)

| Night due | Rate schedule in effect |
|---|---|
| 30 June 2026 | the schedule taking effect 2025-07-01 |
| 1 July 2026 | the schedule taking effect 2026-07-01 |
| 1 July 2025 | the schedule taking effect 2025-07-01 |
| 30 June 2025, on a charge billed 3 July 2025 | the schedule taking effect 2025-07-01, in effect on the billing date |
| 30 April 2025, on a charge billed 3 May 2025 | none: the charge's own daily rate |
